own_solution.law: Grating equation d sin(theta) = m lambda at normal incidence; separation = asin(2*650/4000) - asin(2*450/4000)
assumptions: angles measured from the grating normal

defect_reasons.other: The screen sentences say 'the screen' although the problem introduces no screen; this does not affect the angular answer.

notes: Verified certified answers: 520 nm -> asin(0.26)=15.070 deg, separation 3.8955; 560 nm -> asin(0.28)=16.260 deg, separation 2.7054; 490 nm -> asin(0.245)=14.182 deg, separation 4.7837; base 18.966-13.003=5.9627 deg. All replacement wavelengths stay shorter than 650 nm and all order-2 maxima exist (m*lambda/d < 1). Minimal pairs T30F6/T19FA and TFEEC/TD8FB share 560 nm and differ only in attachment/timing; numeral-free twins T9433/T30F6 and T8CA3/TFEEC differ only by number replaced with 'a different wavelength'. Screen-distance cancellation is correct. Agrees with pass 1.
